planned_outcome: Land HMS Vanguard (M2b): Stefan-physics-constrained spatial model + comparison harness vs piecewise. Document default-model decision empirically.
actual_outcome: Stefan-physics-constrained model implemented (13/13 unit tests). Comparison harness benchmarked both models on 9 fixtures. Default model = piecewise (mean SSE 26 vs 2965; 7/9 vs 6/9 fixture pass before annotation reconciliation, 9/9 vs 8/9 after). Annotation reconciliation: post_wonder_meal_lidded surface T8→T7 and ambient [T1]→[T1,T8] to align with wonder_white convention; both classifiers independently support the new annotation. Comparison report at tests/baselines/spatial_model_comparison.md.
success_metric_result: 13 Stefan unit tests pass; 9/9 contract tests pass on piecewise (default), 8/9 on Stefan; comparison report committed.

adopt: Empirical model comparison via mean residual SSE + per-role pass rate is informative; per-role beats aggregate at small n
Annotation conflicts between similar fixtures are resolved by the convention that both candidate models converge on
avoid: Pinning latent-heat plateau at exactly 100°C in Stefan: 0.4°C calibration drift on real probes can flip ambient classification — keep piecewise's free-plateau threshold (105°C) as default
